defects.summary: save() writes a temp file and then copies it over the target with copyfile, which truncates and rewrites the destination in place; a crash mid-copy leaves a half-written file (os.replace is the atomic step).
snapshot() builds a new dict but reuses the stored entry dicts, so mutating a stored list/dict value (or the entry) after the snapshot changes the snapshot; it needs a deep copy.

decoys.summary: _load returns silently on FileNotFoundError: a store whose file does not exist yet is simply empty; other errors (corrupt JSON) still propagate.
Namespace.keys slices off len(prefix) characters; the prefix includes the colon and startswith(prefix) guards the slice, so 'users2:x' is not listed under 'users'.
